title: Be a Teacher
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: You work at a school, in a bright classroom.
You wear comfy clothes and comfy shoes. You stand up a lot!
You read stories. You teach letters, numbers, and how to be kind.
You get to school early to get the room ready.
Uh-oh! The class hamster got out of his cage.
Where is he? He is asleep in your shoe!
At art time, the glitter spills. Now everyone sparkles, even you!
You work with the principal, other teachers, the librarian, and the school nurse.
The best part? You see a child read a whole book for the first time.
The hardest part? Lots of kids need help at the same time.
At night, you plan tomorrow's lessons.
How do you become a teacher? Go to college for about 4 years. Then practice teaching in a real class with a helper teacher.
What can you do now? Read to a younger kid. Play school with your stuffed animals. Help a friend learn something new.
